renderingIntentProfileNotes: Every built-in RGB and grayscale ICC factory now has an explicit IccRenderingIntent overload supporting Perceptual=0, RelativeColorimetric=1, Saturation=2 and AbsoluteColorimetric=3, porting lib/cms/jpegli_cms_internal.h at the pinned revision. All 23 existing public factory signatures and default perceptual bytes are preserved; XYB remains perceptual-only because the upstream builder rejects other intents. Enum validation throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException renderingIntent. Intent-dependent descriptions use Per/Rel/Sat/Abs, with sRGB and DisplayP3 shortcuts restricted to perceptual and Rec2100PQ/Rec2100HLG shortcuts for relative colorimetric. Description lengths drive aligned tag offsets, including relative HDR profiles at4324 bytes rather than4344. Header intent is stored at offset64; ICC MD5 identification temporarily zeroes flags, intent and profile ID. Colorants, curves, adaptation, CICP and HDR A2B0/B2A0 payloads remain unchanged across intents; intent is a reader preference and does not apply a source conversion. Independently compiled unchanged pinned MSVC ARM64 C++17 /O2 /fp:strict /DNDEBUG fixtures cover all22 RGB/grayscale factories times4 intents, with every perceptual fixture matching the prior regression lineage. Complete-profile SHA256 and ID checks, independent parsing and representative typed/progressive/nonseekable embedding regressions validate serialization and sample preservation. Rendering-intent combinations are complete for existing RGB/grayscale factories; other transfer/white-point combinations and arbitrary source ICC color management remain pending. No color-managed JPEG quality or reader-specific rendering parity is claimed.

extendedQuantizationNotes: JpegliEncoderOptions.ForceBaseline defaults true and preserves existing bytes. False ports the pinned quant.cc SetQuantMatrices and QuantValsToDistance range1..32767 across perceptual YCbCr/grayscale, standard/RGB and XYB generation, with finite float clamping before integer conversion. QuantizationTables are final-value snapshots validated against the selected range; zero or values above32767 are rejected in extended mode instead of upstream add_quant_table clamping. The supported range follows generated/add_quant_table limits rather than arbitrary installed UINT16 tables. QuantValuesToDistance uses the selected saturation endpoint, so255 becomes an ordinary rounded value when false and can affect adaptive YCbCr thresholds even with eight-bit DQT. Uniform grayscale/RGB/XYB multipliers remain. bitstream.cc EncodeDQT/EncodeSOF rules select Pq0 per table whose values fit255, otherwise Pq1 with64 network-byte-order words; mixed tables share a correctly sized DQT. Sequential output uses SOF1 iff any table is wide, otherwise SOF0; progressive retainsSOF2. Sample precision stays8. Existing selectors, scan scripts, separate sequential scans, restarts, coefficient preflight, source precision/layout, sampling, metadata and bounded stream contracts apply. Independent marker/entropy parsing, coefficient and decoder checks validate these contracts without establishing encoder byte, size, quality or speed parity.
scanScriptNotes: JpegliEncoderOptions.ScanScript and JpegScan expose complete caller-supplied jpeg_scan_info schedules from pinned lib/jpegli/encode.cc. Null preserves existing bytes; the first scan's spectral range determines sequential or progressive output, overriding Progressive. Components are strictly increasing zero-based output indices within each scan; component groups can be scheduled in any order. Validation snapshots the outer list and every selector list before output, enforces sequential full scans or progressive DC-only or single-component AC ranges, initial Ah0, adjacent refinement bits0..10, DC before component AC, and complete full-precision coefficient coverage. The pinned ProcessCompressionParams limit of252 AC contexts plus at most33 DC scans bounds scripts to285 entries; existing legacy band controls retain their limits. Explicit script conflicts with other scan customization, raising ArgumentException ScanScript before output. Singleton scans use real component block raster order; multi-component subsets use frame MCU geometry and existing dummy DC continuity. Histogram and emission share traversal, with raw-bit DC refinements skipped in frequency collection, bounded coefficient recomputation, per-scan DRI/restart geometry and reset predictor/EOB/RST state. Existing quantization, adaptive analysis, input precision, source layout, metadata, coefficient preflight and stream contracts apply. Independent marker/Huffman decoding verifies explicit descriptors, changing DC groups, split/joined AC refinement ranges and final real coefficients, plus decoded-pixel parity, default/preset bytes, snapshots and rejection before output. This does not establish upstream encoder byte, size, quality or speed parity.
sequentialScansNotes: JpegliEncoderOptions.SequentialInterleaveComponents defaults true and preserves existing interleaved baseline bytes. False selects one complete sequential scan per output component in frame order, supported by the pinned lib/jpegli/encode.cc ValidateScanScript and ProcessCompressionParams custom scan_info path. SOF0 and each SOS Ss0/Se63/Ah0/Al0 retain full DC/AC coding with existing EntropyEncoder. Real component blocks traverse raster order without wholly padded MCU blocks; each block is one MCU. Matching histogram and output traversal share component-specific restart intervals, per-scan DRI updates and predictor/RST resets. Grayscale retains existing bytes. False conflicts with effective progressive output, rejecting with ArgumentException SequentialInterleaveComponents before output; ProgressiveLevel0 overrides Progressive and is allowed. Quantization, adaptive thresholds, source precision/layout, smoothing, sampling, metadata, bounded storage, coefficient preflight and stream contracts retain existing behavior. Independent marker/Huffman parsing reconstructs real coefficients and verifies restarts, with decoded-pixel parity checks. This exposes a fixed separate-component sequential script, not arbitrary scripts or the default upstream level0 preset, and does not establish encoder byte, size, quality or speed parity.
customQuantizationNotes: JpegliEncoderOptions.QuantizationTables accepts final natural-order quantizers corresponding to jpegli_add_quant_table with scale100 and selected force_baseline at the pinned encode.cc. Each table is exactly64 ushort values1..255, or1..32767 with ForceBaseline false; invalid shapes/values reject with ArgumentException for QuantizationTables before output, rather than upstream scaling/clamping. Null retains automatic tables and bytes. Grayscale requires1 table; color accepts1/2/3 with selectors0/0/0,0/1/1,0/1/2 in YCbCr, RGB or scaled XYB component order. Caller list/data are snapshotted to encoder-owned arrays before output and never modified. Custom values override generated Quality/Distance/standard/sampling/transfer matrix scaling while ignored options remain validated. Explicit selectors drive both DQT/SOF and YCbCr QuantValsToDistance base-matrix indexing; component-specific bias multipliers remain, and grayscale/RGB/XYB retain uniform adaptive behavior. Coefficient preflight, Huffman histograms and all scans use the same snapshot. Existing sampling, ICC requirements, restarts, typed inputs and stream contracts apply. ForceBaseline false enables extended quantizers as described separately; this does not enable lossless JPEG or full encoder byte/quality/speed parity.
restartRowsNotes: JpegliEncoderOptions.RestartRows ports positive restart_in_rows handling from lib/jpegli/encode.cc ProcessCompressionParams and changed-interval DRI emission from lib/jpegli/bitstream.cc WriteScanHeader at the pinned revision. Zero preserves RestartInterval and existing JPEG bytes; positive rows override the still-validated fixed interval. Each scan uses min((long)rows * MCUs_per_row,65535): frame MCU columns for interleaved scans, real component block columns for single-component DC/AC scans. Shared per-scan intervals drive histogram collection and output; full-coefficient preflight retains baseline interleaved traversal. DRI is emitted before the first nonzero interval and whenever it changes between scans, with RST numbering reset per scan. Managed validation rejects negative row counts, while upstream treats nonpositive restart_in_rows as fixed-interval mode. Source precisions, custom sampling, grayscale, RGB/XYB, spectral bands, mixed refinement depths and progression presets retain their existing coefficient and stream contracts. Independent marker/entropy parsing derives expected geometry from emitted SOF/SOS, checks DRI changes and RST boundaries, and reconstructs coefficients without reusing encoder restart logic. This does not establish full encoder byte, size, quality or speed parity.
progressionLevelNotes: JpegliEncoderOptions.ProgressiveLevel ports SetDefaultScanScript and jpegli_set_progressive_level from lib/jpegli/encode.cc at the pinned revision. Null retains existing custom progressive settings and bytes; zero selects baseline sequential regardless of Progressive; one sends full-precision DC then AC1..63 with Al1 followed by Ah1/Al0 refinement; all levels>=2 send full-precision DC, AC1..2 full precision, AC3..63 with Al2 then Ah2/Al1 and Ah1/Al0 refinement. Negative levels reject. DC interleaving depends on both maximum selected output sampling factors being exactly1; otherwise each component has a real-block raster DC scan. Grayscale output resolves to1x1. All component scans for a spectral/bit descriptor precede the next descriptor. Explicit levels conflict with explicit AC ends/depth lists, nonzero DC refinement depth and disabled DC interleaving, with ParamName ProgressiveLevel before output. Immutable effective options reuse existing bounded coefficient recomputation, optimized/default Huffman handling and per-scan restarts; quantization and final coefficients are unchanged. Matching scan descriptors does not establish encoder byte parity, quality/size parity or speed parity.

xybProfileNotes: JpegliIccProfiles.CreateXybProfile builds a fresh deterministic 720-byte scaled XYB ICC v4.4 profile in managed code, porting the fixed D65/perceptual branch of lib/cms/jpegli_cms_internal.h and lib/cms/opsin_params.h. progressiveSpectralBandNotes: Optional ProgressiveAcScanEnds defines a validated complete ordered partition of JPEG zigzag positions 1..63; null retains one full AC scan and existing JPEG bytes. Initial and refinement AC tokenization loops use inclusive spectral ranges, following lib/jpegli/entropy_coding.cc TokenizeACProgressiveScan and TokenizeACRefinementScan. Each round sends DC then bands outer/components inner; EOB state and restart cycling reset at every scan. Shared optimized AC histograms include all bands and refinement passes. Null ProgressiveAcRefinementBits uses the existing uniform ProgressiveRefinementBits. An explicit copied list sets each AC band depth0..10 while the scalar retains DC depth; refinement rounds descend from the maximum DC/AC depth, skipping completed ranges. Frequency collection follows the same AC passes. Ends[2,63], AC depths[0,2], DC depth0 match lib/jpegli/encode.cc SetDefaultScanScript level2 spectral/bit descriptors: DC and positions1..2 full precision, positions3..63 two deferred bits then refinement2-to1-to0. ProgressiveInterleaveDc defaults true, preserving interleaved MCU traversal and dummy blocks. False requires Progressive and sends each component's real blocks in raster order for initial and refinement DC, following encode.cc single-component MCU geometry and entropy_coding.cc TokenizeScan. Frequency collection has the same predictor resets and each component block counts as one restart MCU; RST numbering resets per scan. Grayscale bytes are unchanged. With those level2 bands and depths, false matches the upstream component/spectral/refinement schedule when either maximum sampling factor exceeds1; true matches its full-resolution interleaving rule. Managed SOS keeps unused table selectors zero, unlike pinned EncodeSOS; scan ordering does not establish encoder-byte or compression parity. List snapshot and validation precede output; final quantized coefficients remain unchanged.
xybConversionNotes: Explicit Xyb output also converts sRGB byte/ushort/float RGB, BGR, alpha layouts and replicated grayscale through direct normalized input, sign-preserving piecewise sRGB decoding, the pinned opsin matrix at intensity255 with finite biased absorbance clamped to zero, cube roots minus the bias root, then ScaleXYBRow constants and JPEG scaling. Normalization follows extras ToFloatRow double reciprocals for integers and unchanged source floats. MathF.Pow/Cbrt replace upstream rational/fast approximations, with native scalar fixtures allowing0.0025 JPEG sample units and an independent double oracle. Conversion reads on demand with bounded storage and applies before smoothing, sampling and Y-based AQ. Float nonlinear computations and out-of-range coefficients are validated before output. A caller-supplied matching scaled XYB output ICC remains required and opaque; a separate managed factory supplies the pinned perceptual profile, with no source ICC management. Automatic defaults and direct scaled XYB bytes are retained; YCbCr-to-XYB and XYB-to-other remain unsupported.
xybInputNotes: Xyb24/Xyb accept already ScaleXYBRow-scaled X/Y/B-minus-Y samples, using existing byte/ushort/float normalization. Automatic selects Xyb for this input; scaled XYB-to-other conversions are rejected. A nonempty caller ICC describing scaled XYB is required, embedded opaque and unchanged. These direct layouts bypass RGB linearization, opsin transform and XYB scaling; a separate managed factory provides the matching perceptual output profile. RGB container IDs R/G/B omit JFIF/Adobe, share Huffman0, but default to separate perceptual XYB quantizers0/1/2 with global scale1.43951668 and nonlinear distance scaling. Standard-table/CICP hints do not alter quantization; default factors2x2/2x2/1x1 ignore the preset. Custom factors map X/Y/B-minus-Y, with AQ on unsmoothed Y, disabled when Y is subsampled, using RGB uniform0.5 AC multipliers/offsets and zero disabled bias. Existing smoothing/edge/progressive/refinement/restart/metadata and finite coefficient preflight paths apply. This does not establish color-managed roundtrip or full encoder parity.
outputColorSpaceNotes: ColorSpace Automatic preserves existing grayscale/YCbCr defaults and selects Xyb for scaled XYB input. Explicit Grayscale converts RGB luminance or consumes only Y from direct YCbCr; YCbCr output accepts grayscale with neutral 128 chroma, deliberately differing from the pinned GrayscaleToYCbCr zero-fill helper. RGB preserves normalized R/G/B layouts or replicates grayscale, rejects direct YCbCr input, emits R/G/B IDs without JFIF/Adobe, and defaults to shared Annex K luma quantizer 0 and Huffman 0. RGB defaults to 1x1 regardless preset; custom Luma/Cb/Cr factors map to R/G/B. AQ analyzes green, disables for subsampled green and uses uniform 0.5 AC multipliers/offsets; disabled RGB bias is 0. Transfer hints and UseStandardQuantizationTables do not change RGB output. This extends normalized BGR/alpha layouts beyond upstream RGB transform support, adds no profile generation or color management, and RGB output does not perform the separately available explicit Xyb conversion.
iccTransferLookupNotes: Opt-in InferCicpTransferFunctionFromIccProfile applies only when CicpTransferFunction is 2; every explicit non-2 code overrides lookup. Ported from FindCICPTag and LookupCICPTransferFunctionFromICCProfile in lib/extras/enc/jpegli.cc: complete directory, last cicp entry, declared size >=12, readable first12 payload bytes with cicp type, transfer at byte9. Invalid or absent lookup falls back2 and ICC embedding remains unchanged. Header fields, other CICP fields, reserved bytes and declared extent beyond12 are not validated, matching the raw helper. Unlike upstream's uint32 count arithmetic, bounds use division before indexing to prevent overflow. Constant working storage and periodic cancellation, no profile transform or generation.
transferFunctionNotes: CicpTransferFunction defaults to 2 (unspecified) and accepts 0..255, rejecting aliases that upstream's int setter would narrow to uint8_t. Codes 16 (PQ) and 18 (HLG) multiply perceptual global scale by 0.4 and 0.5 before 4:2:0 compensation. Other codes preserve default tuning. QuantValsToDistance uses the same transfer scale without 4:2:0 compensation, including standard shared-chroma selectors; standard table generation itself ignores the hint. No sample conversion, color management, CICP marker or automatic profile is provided, and eight-bit output does not establish HDR conformance.
standardQuantizationNotes: Opt-in UseStandardQuantizationTables uses the pinned quant.cc Annex K luma and shared chroma matrices, scaled by 0.01 * DistanceToLinearQuality(resolved distance), rounded and clamped to 1..255 without 4:2:0 compensation. Clamping precedes integer conversion, including immediately below distance 25 where upstream's conversion overflows; native parity is not claimed for that edge. Color emits table IDs 0/1 and frame selectors 0/1/1; grayscale emits only 0. Adaptive inference uses upstream quant_tbl_no indexing, including the perceptual Cb base for both chroma components, while zero-bias multipliers remain component-specific. This is not libjpeg byte or quality parity; the default retains perceptual tables and existing bytes.
distanceNotes: Optional positive finite Distance overrides Quality while keeping Quality validation. Null uses the public fractional QualityToDistance polynomial and preserves existing bytes. The resolved distance controls table generation in all input and scan paths; adaptive multipliers remain table-derived. Tables clamp to baseline 1..255 even at finite float extremes; upstream C++ overflow behavior at such extremes is not a parity claim. Distance is not a measured or guaranteed perceptual error, and encoding remains lossy.
iptcNotes: Raw opaque IPTC-IIM data is embedded in one Photoshop APP13 resource 0x0404 with an empty Pascal name, unsigned big-endian unpadded data length and even-byte padding. The single-marker input limit is 65,506 bytes. No IIM validation, text conversion, digest resource or XMP/Exif reconciliation is performed.
automaticXmpNotes: Opt-in oversized standard packets move their full XML root into extended XMP with a generated digest-only standard packet by default. StandardXmpProperties can retain complete selected top-level attributes and elements in a compact standard envelope, preserving inherited namespaces and XML attributes, with pre-output validation of its final UTF-8 size including the digest link. Parsing requires ordinary empty-subject XMP envelopes and uses packet-sized storage. Smaller and manually partitioned packets retain their existing bytes.
samplingNotes: Integer sample areas use frame-wide component factor maxima, including subsampled luma with adaptive quantization disabled as upstream. Three-row areas include all three rows; the pinned ChooseDownsampleMethods instead selects two-row kernels for vertical factor 3.
floatInputNotes: Out-of-range float input is opt-in and retains samples without clipping. Unlike upstream coefficient storage, a bounded preflight requires finite scaling and computation, rounded DC -1024..1023 and AC -1023..1023 before output, independently of scan or Huffman settings.
srgbProfileNotes: JpegliIccProfiles.CreateSrgbProfile builds a fresh deterministic 504-byte perceptual ICC v4.4 RGB display profile, porting the fixed D65/sRGB branch of lib/cms/jpegli_cms_internal.h with precise primaries from lib/cms/color_encoding_cms.h. Tags include desc sRGB, cprt CC0, D50 wtpt, D65-to-D50 Bradford chad, cicp [1,13,0,1], adapted rXYZ/gXYZ/bXYZ and rTRC/gTRC/bTRC sharing one type3 parametric sRGB decoding curve. Canonical adapted float colorants are precomputed from the unchanged upstream builder; shared managed serialization preserves XYB profile bytes. Fixed upstream timestamp, flags, intent and MD5 ID retain reproducible bytes. Exact native profile SHA256 1406EFC5429250FEBE778C182EB5E5168AA14B2CAEFCF772211A2EC2ECF31659 and ID A3379298068DF11976289D87A33230AA were generated by compiling the unchanged pinned header with MSVC C++17 /fp:strict. Explicit IccProfile assignment only; describes sRGB RGB interpretation of RGB or YCbCr output, not grayscale or scaled XYB. No sample conversion, source ICC management or automatic attachment. Independent tag/curve/matrix parsing and sRGB-to-D50-XYZ oracles validate the profile, not an end-to-end lossy JPEG quality comparison.
displayP3ProfileNotes: JpegliIccProfiles.CreateDisplayP3Profile builds a fresh deterministic 516-byte perceptual ICC v4.4 RGB display profile by porting the fixed P3/D65/sRGB-transfer branches of lib/cms/jpegli_cms_internal.h, with P3 primaries from lib/cms/color_encoding_cms.h: R=(0.680,0.320), G=(0.265,0.690), B=(0.150,0.060). Shared Internal/RgbIccProfile serialization preserves existing sRGB and linear-sRGB bytes. Tags include desc DisplayP3, cprt CC0, D50 wtpt, D65-to-D50 Bradford chad, adapted colorants, CICP [12,13,0,1] and shared type3 sRGB decoding curves. Canonical adapted float colorants come from the unchanged pinned builder. Fixed upstream timestamp, flags, perceptual intent and MD5 ID retain reproducible bytes. An independently compiled MSVC ARM64 C++17 /O2 /fp:strict fixture has SHA256 A35258ED146F3F0A6A24C25B102AAF2A02C9721CBB647422FA5A3F1CFD132C96 and ID DF9F5B76A9627A080C7EDDA1399115DC. Explicit output-profile assignment only, for already Display P3 samples in RGB or YCbCr output; no sample conversion, gamut mapping, automatic attachment or source ICC color management. It is unsuitable for grayscale, scaled XYB, linear-light P3 or DCI-P3. Explicit XYB conversion still requires gamma-encoded sRGB input and the scaled XYB profile. Independent native-byte comparison, tag/curve/matrix oracles and encoding checks validate serialization and sample preservation, not a color-managed lossy JPEG quality comparison.
rec2100ProfileNotes: JpegliIccProfiles.CreateRec2100PqProfile and CreateRec2100HlgProfile build fresh deterministic 4344-byte perceptual ICC v4.4 RGB display profiles from the fixed Rec2020/D65 PQ and HLG branches of lib/cms/jpegli_cms_internal.h with default JPEGLI_ENABLE_3D_ICC_TONEMAPPING=1. Descriptions RGB_D65_202_Per_PeQ and RGB_D65_202_Per_HLG; Lab PCS, D50 wtpt, D65-to-D50 Bradford chad, shared existing Rec2020 adapted colorants, CICP [9,16,0,1] or [9,18,0,1]. A2B0 is mft1 with identity matrix, 256-entry identity input/output curves and a 9x9x9 eight-bit RGB-to-Lab CLUT. PQ decodes at 10000 nits then applies the pinned BT.2408 mapper to 250 nits; HLG applies the pinned 300-to-80-nit OOTF adjustment. Both apply scalar gamut mapping with preservation weight 0.3 before D50 Lab conversion. B2A0 is an identity compatibility mBA tag, not an inverse. Numerical helpers port float/double evaluation order from transfer_functions.h and tone_mapping.h. Independently compiled unchanged pinned MSVC ARM64 C++17 /O2 /fp:strict fixture: PQ SHA256 B2F97E195A8C64DD55EFF71FC1DF480A12E59D71105D7D9DABFCC23F9252C48E and ID 22BC30F3E3B03923D34FE5CF368CCFA6; HLG SHA256 CB3A3012517E21922D895462F66841F6EDEDDE8031CC3CD3041A12AF8536A556 and ID D2BA1D3F609E15C6612C1CDE2CC98D15. Explicit output-profile assignment for already full-range Rec2100 samples, RGB or corresponding YCbCr output; no source conversion, limited-range expansion, encoder tone mapping or automatic attachment. Opt-in CICP inference selects existing PQ/HLG tuning in YCbCr paths; explicit transfer hints override it. A compatible display CMM may use the tone-mapping LUT or CICP directly. Output remains lossy eight-bit JPEG and profile embedding does not establish HDR display or Rec2100 conformance.
additionalGrayscaleProfileNotes: JpegliIccProfiles.CreateRec709GrayscaleProfile, CreateDciGrayscaleProfile, CreateRec2100PqGrayscaleProfile and CreateRec2100HlgGrayscaleProfile build fresh deterministic perceptual ICC v4.4 grayscale display profiles from the GRAY branches of lib/cms/jpegli_cms_internal.h. Shared Internal/GrayscaleIccProfile serialization preserves existing sRGB and linear grayscale bytes. Rec709/DCI are 328 bytes with type3 BT.709 or gamma2.6 decoding curves; PQ/HLG are 436 bytes with 64-entry curv tables. Descriptions Gra_D65_Per_709, Gra_DCI_Per_DCI, Gra_D65_Per_PeQ and Gra_D65_Per_HLG. All retain source media white (D65 except DCI xy=(0.314,0.351)), D50 XYZ PCS header and four tags desc/cprt/wtpt/kTRC; no chad, CICP, colorants or 3D LUT. HDR table generation follows CreateTableCurve<64> float grid i/63, double transfer arithmetic returning float via copysignf, double scaling by65535 followed by roundf; CanToneMap=false for grayscale so PQ remains normalized to10000 nits and HLG has no OOTF. Explicit output-profile assignment for already full-range transfer-encoded grayscale samples; no source conversion, limited-range expansion, automatic attachment or encoder tone mapping. Independent native bytes, parsed transfer curves/tables and encoding checks validate serialization and sample preservation without claiming color-managed lossy JPEG quality, HDR display, Rec2100 or digital-cinema conformance.
